name: Bloodseed: The last Helsing
detailed_description:
We have lost the war against the vampires. They won, and now the world belongs to them. However, the 5 families are in conflict, and it is your only opportunity, you, the last descendant of the Helsing lineage, to counterattack and reclaim what belongs to us. Humanity.

ABOUT BLOODSEED

Bloodseed is a game that combines two very distinct but terribly addictive genres; card combat and survival.

CHOOSE YOUR PATH

You will have to reclaim the 5 territories dominated by the great families. To do this, you must choose your path among several options without knowing what you will encounter ahead.

COMBAT BY CARDS

On one side, it’s a deck-building game where you must acquire cards and improve them to defeat the vampire lords.

By defeating them, you will gain weapons and vampire blood, which are very useful for upgrading your weapons in the survivor this mode, you can defeat families and reclaim territories, which will offer you significant advantages during the game.

HORDE MODE

In this mode, you must withstand the attack of hordes of subjects and worshippers using your weapons and abilities while gathering as much blood as possible.

If you survive, you will be able to open the chest that grants you new cards, and you can upgrade them with the collected blood.

NON-LINEAR STORY

In Bloodseed, no game is the same as the cards and weapons you find can be unlocked in the next game. Additionally, you can start by attacking any region, as doing so will grant you different advantages and the other families will strengthen.

It is the time of men, it is the time to honor your lineage.
